items.text: Lamar Jackson officially OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals after earlier QUESTIONABLE; Tyler Huntley expected to start. Rapoport notes he was close and should return next week.
items.why: Downgraded Saturday from Q; high ankle sprain, third straight miss.
items.implication: Fade Lamar completely; Huntley is low-ceiling QB2/stream with limited upside in fantasy/DFS.
items.opportunity: Reduced Ravens offense efficiency; potential slight bump to Zay Flowers/Mark Andrews/Isaiah Likely volume but overall lower ceiling.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT for Eagles Monday vs Cowboys. Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (Q).
items.why: Officially ruled out Saturday/Sunday reports; Saquon expected despite Q.
items.implication: Major Eagles WR vacuum; A.J. Brown and Dallas Goedert see massive target/route upgrades. Saquon strong RB1 if active.
items.opportunity: Brown/Goedert target share spike; possible CMC-like slot usage for others but primary to remaining skill.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (despite Q) for Monday vs DAL; DeVonta/Wicks OUT creates extra volume around him.
items.implication: Strong RB1 start vs soft DAL run D; Berry loves if active.
items.opportunity: Full workload + pass-game with WRs out.

items.text: Rams optimistic Puka Nacua (calf, Q) will play vs Raiders; felt better Saturday, 'as long as no setbacks we feel good about him being available.' ETR lists GTD/OPTIMISM.
items.why: Improved Saturday; McVay/sources confident barring setback. Adams already OUT.
items.implication: Lock in as WR1/elite play if active; massive volume with Davante Adams out.
items.opportunity: Full route/target share expected; red-zone primary. Reverse any fade/stale beneficiary plans.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) unlikely to play today vs Dolphins after missing three games; may workout but not full participant yet, 'a bit early.' ETR GTD/PESSIMISM.
items.why: Limited practice only; sources say early for return.
items.implication: Sit/fade Hall; Braelon Allen becomes lead back and strong RB2/flex with expanded snaps/carries.
items.opportunity: Allen inherits primary carries, routes, goal-line in good matchup.

items.text: All ETR projections updated to reflect latest news (Lamar OUT, Puka optimism, Breece pessimism, INs, Saquon expected, Smith/Wicks OUT).
items.why: Direct response to morning status summary.
items.implication: Use updated numbers for start/sit/DFS; reflects all key changes.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo back in as the lead back.
items.why: Insiders report on GameDay; expected primary role.
items.implication: Startable RB2/flex with full snap/carry opportunity; Berry hates the HOU matchup.

items.text: Lamar Jackson was close to playing this week, should next week. Rams confident Puka will play. Baker Mayfield returns.
items.implication: Hold Lamar for Week 8; confirm Puka play.

items.text: Activated and expected to play: Josh Jacobs, Jordan Mason, Jonah Coleman, Tank Dell, Christian Kirk + others.
items.why: Official activations Saturday; expected Sunday contributions.
items.implication: Jacobs debut impactful for GB run; others add depth/competition (e.g. Mason Vikings RB).
items.opportunity: Immediate snaps possible; monitor for committee vs lead.

items.text: Packers activated Josh Jacobs from exempt list; expected to play Sunday at Detroit in season debut after long absence.
items.why: Activated Saturday; practiced, first-team reps. Packers run game last in league without him.
items.implication: Immediate RB2/flex consideration but monitor snap share post-layoff; Berry hates due to workload uncertainty.
items.opportunity: Likely lead back carries/goal-line; handcuff/backup role shrinks for others like Marshawn Lloyd.
items.conflict: Berry ranks/hates post-layoff volume risk vs Lions.

items.text: Lamar/Puka/Breece statuses crucial to Sunday DFS main slate. Sneaky important scratches: Brian Robinson, Tyler Warren, Emeka Egbuka (plus Jahwar Jordan). Tempted by CMC more slot WR usage amid 49ers WR outs despite usual skepticism on RB-as-WR.
items.why: Dire 49ers WR situation (Evans/Deebo out) + Kaelon Black presence makes CMC slot more plausible than usual empty talk.
items.implication: CMC elevated ceiling as pass-catcher; fade/scratch the sneaky OUTs for beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: CMC routes/targets up; Bijan full workload if BRob out; other backups elevated.
items.conflict: Rarely trusts RB-WR statements but situation overrides.

items.text: Sat night dump: Q Lamar/Puka/Breece/Baker/Rico Dowdle/etc; OUT Mike Evans/Deebo/Davante Adams/Rashee Rice/Jeremiyah Love/David Montgomery/Emeka Egbuka/Tyler Warren/Zach Charbonnet/Brian Robinson; IN Jacobs/Judkins/Addison/Hockenson/etc.
items.why: Comprehensive weekend report matching key stars and depth.
items.implication: Direct opps: Bijan bellcow (BRob out), no Rice/Adams/Love/Mont/Egbuka/Warren; Judkins/Addison active boosts.
items.opportunity: Snap/role expansion for handcuffs and remaining WRs/TEs; reverse if any flip to IN.

items.text: Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren among key OUTs.
items.why: Confirmed in full dump; Adams hamstring etc.
items.implication: Puka/Kyren elevated further in LAR; KC WRs (Worthy etc) up without Rice; no Mont means other HOU RBs; IND TE vacuum without Warren.
items.opportunity: Clear role expansion for teammates: e.g. Kyren full, backup TEs/RBs.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown (usage/matchup vs CHI), Tucker Kraft (TE buffet vs DET Lions D allowing many TE TDs/fantasy pts), Jaylen Warren/Chuba Hubbard/Bucky Irving (volume in friendly spots). Saquon if active. Jonah Coleman 100% roster.
items.why: Bears good for yardage; Lions D gift to pass catchers/TEs (9 TE TDs); big workloads + matchups for RBs. Coleman end-of-year Broncos RB.
items.implication: Start these; roster Coleman immediately. Brown elevated further with Smith/Wicks OUT.
items.opportunity: High target/carry/red-zone shares in plus spots.

items.text: Rico Dowdle and DeShon Elliott both up (active) for Steelers vs Saints.
items.implication: Dowdle available in PIT backfield; potential committee or lead depending on game script.
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps available in Paris early game.

items.text: Jonah Coleman will be the Broncos RB you wish you had by year end; roster in 100% of leagues (activated/expected).
items.why: Prior production before injury; Dobbins/Harvey inefficient; long-term upside.
items.implication: Priority add for Broncos RB committee/future lead.

items.text: Top-10 overall Week 7: Gibbs, Bijan, CMC, Kenneth Walker, Kyren, JSN, Puka, Chase, Henry, Amon-Ra. Warren top-15; includes Saquon ~17, Jacobs lower.
items.why: Updated heading into Sunday with injury context; Puka ranked high on optimism.
items.implication: Strong starts for top; Warren upgrade signal.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze (shadowed by Gonzalez, outside routes), Josh Downs (target share/low-scoring), Travis Kelce (tough SEA D), Josh Jacobs (post-layoff workload questions vs DET).
items.why: Nasty matchups + role/volume concerns; Jacobs long layoff risk.
items.implication: Sit/fade these; Jacobs monitor snaps closely despite activation.
items.opportunity: Lower floors; prefer alternatives with clearer roles.
items.conflict: Jacobs expected to play/lead but volume TBD.
